items.source: Creates a new MongoDataIntegrityViolationException using the given message and WriteConcernResult.
items.translation: 使用给定的消息和WriteConcernResult创建一个新的MongoDataIntegrityViolationException。

items.source: Returns the MongoActionOperation in which the current exception occurred.
items.translation: 返回当前异常发生的MongoActionOperation。

items.source: Returns the WriteConcernResult that caused the exception.

items.source: actionOperation - the MongoActionOperation that caused the exception, must not be null.
items.translation: actionOperation - 导致异常的MongoActionOperation，不能为 null。

items.source: writeResult - the WriteConcernResult that causes the exception, must not be null.
items.translation: writeResult - 导致异常的 WriteConcernResult，不能为 null。
